title: guatteria cryandra

This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
